title: Invariant separating parameters for a semilinear finite action
statement: Let $k\subseteq E$ be a finitely generated field extension, let $d=\operatorname{trdeg}_kE$, and suppose that $E\otimes_k K$ is an integral domain for every extension field $K/k$. Here the tensor product is the commutative tensor-product algebra, with $(a\otimes b)(c\otimes e)=ac\otimes be$. Let a finite group $H$ act on $E$ and on $k$ by field automorphisms, with $h(a)$ computed in $E$ equal to the image of $h(a)$ computed in $k$ for $a\in k$. No faithfulness is required. There are $t_1,\ldots,t_d\in E^H$, where $E^H=\{a\in E:h(a)=a\ \forall h\in H\}$, algebraically independent over $k$, such that $E/k(t_1,\ldots,t_d)$ is finite separable. Algebraically independent means that no nonzero polynomial over $k$ in these $d$ elements vanishes; finite separable means finite-dimensional with separable minimal polynomials. The empty family is allowed when $d=0$. Fields, extensions and transcendence degree use [def-weil-field], [def-pc-field-extension] and [def-kun-transcendence-degree]; generated subfields and separating bases use [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis] and [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension].

proof.text: Put $k_0=k^H$ and $F=E^H$. The finite compatible actions and finite generation of $E/k$ satisfy [lem-sfb-semilinear-fixed-field-finite-generation]. Hence $k_0\subseteq F$, $k/k_0$ and $E/F$ are finite separable, and $E/k_0$ and $F/k_0$ are finitely generated. This applies without faithfulness of either action.

source.place: Agent extraction of former steps 1-3 of lem-sfb-invariant-separating-parameters: apply Tag 09I3 (lemma-galois-over-fixed-field) to the two automorphism images, use its orbit polynomials and Tag 09GH (lemma-algebraic-finitely-generated) to obtain a finite coefficient field, then the finite-dimensional-subspace argument. Serves de Jong Lemma 5.2 proof, printed p.613, invariant parameter choice.

proof.text: The assumed domains $E\otimes_kK$ are reduced: a nilpotent $x$ has $x^n=0$, and absence of zero divisors gives $x=0$. Apply [lem-sfb-geometric-subfield-scalar-restriction] to the two towers $k_0\subseteq k\subseteq E$ and $k_0\subseteq F\subseteq E$. Step 1 gives its separable algebraicity and algebraicity hypotheses. It yields geometric reducedness of $F/k_0$ and $\operatorname{trdeg}_{k_0}F=\operatorname{trdeg}_kE=d$.

source.place: Agent extraction of former steps 4-6 of lem-sfb-invariant-separating-parameters: Tag 0C2Y (lemma-geometrically-reduced-over-separable-algebraic), followed by tensor injectivity for the subfield inclusion and two applications of fields.tex Tag 030H (lemma-transcendence-degree-tower). Serves de Jong Lemma 5.2 proof, printed p.613.

proof.text: Steps 1 and 2 verify every hypothesis of [lem-sfb-separating-basis-algebraic-diamond]: both fields are finitely generated over $k_0$, $k/k_0$ is algebraic, $E/F$ is separable algebraic, and $F/k_0$ is geometrically reduced of transcendence degree $d$. It supplies $t_1,\ldots,t_d\in F$, algebraically independent over $k$, with $E/k(t_1,\ldots,t_d)$ finite separable. Membership in $F=E^H$ means each parameter is fixed by every $h\in H$. The lemma includes $d=0$, so this also gives the permitted empty family.
